description: List comments with their post, author, content, date and approval status. Filter by post_id, status, search text, user_id or author_email. Returns 10 unless limit is set. With type set to "note", it lists the editor notes on posts, where an approval status of 1 means the note thread is resolved.

author_email.description: Filter by the commenter email address.

type.description: Filter by comment type, e.g. "comment", "pingback", or "note" (WP 6.9 editor Notes). Omit to return all types.

user_id.description: Filter by the registered user ID of the commenter.

name: wp_get_comments
title: List comments
